name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.1): one row on Reconciliation Statements (CA302000) can now be ticked and unticked through aspx_grid_batch, proven on 2026R1. The classic page tools could not open a statement there: they sent commands in a case the page ignores, and typed the cash account into a dialog's box of the same name. Both now come from the page itself. A warning standing on a grid no longer reads as a failed save, so a row that saved is verified and reported as saved, and an empty record no longer counts as loaded. Ticking Reconciled also sets Cleared, so undoing a tick sends both. 0.81.0 fixed three silent failures found testing AP Invoice Processing. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
